Andhra Pradesh Seeks Foreign Investment in Tourism Sector

The Indian government has invited foreign investors to explore opportunities in the tourism sector of Andhra Pradesh. Minister Durgesh has expressed interest in attracting investments that can boost the state's economy and create jobs. The move is seen as a step towards diversifying the state's revenue streams and reducing its dependence on agriculture. As the country looks to promote its cultural heritage and natural beauty, Andhra Pradesh aims to become a major tourist destination.
